node: Compliant rare-earth magnets and qualified non-Chinese feedstock
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expanded the direct public-company universe for the rare-earth magnet compliance node. The strongest direct exposure is not broad mining alone, but companies attempting to control qualified non-Chinese feedstock, oxide separation, metal/alloy conversion, and NdFeB magnet output. MP Materials is the obvious reference leader; USA Rare Earth and Energy Fuels are the more relevant underfollowed public discovery candidates because they sit closer to the magnet/feedstock qualification bottleneck than generic critical-minerals names. NioCorp is included only as a speculative shadow because its rare-earth relevance is plausible but project-stage and needs stronger qualification/offtake evidence. Layer 1B expansion focused on the scarce, policy-sensitive layer beneath headline rare-earth mining: qualified non-Chinese rare-earth oxides, heavy rare-earth feedstock, monazite supply, and magnet manufacturing capacity that can satisfy defense-origin and customer-certification requirements. The two-lane universe keeps MP Materials as the reference anchor, but the underfollowed lane points to Energy Fuels as a U.S. oxide/separation bottleneck, Chemours as a less obvious domestic monazite/feedstock supplier, and Critical Metals as a speculative heavy-rare-earth feedstock candidate tied to North American processors. No buy/sell view is implied.
